data.name: Rayhaanah
data.gender_notes: Rayhaanah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Rayhaanah is a type of sweet fragrant plant mentioned in the Quran. It symbolizes pleasantness and beauty. The name Rayhaanah carries the meaning “Sweet fragrant plant” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Rayhaanah usually hope their child will grow to embody sweet fragrant plant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, Rayhaanah is associated with paradise and its pleasant fragrances.
data.etymology: Rayhaanah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Sweet fragrant plant.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rayhaanah total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_arabic.name: ريحانة
in_arabic.meaning: ريحانة تعني النبات الجميل ذو الرائحة الطيبة
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم ريحانة مشتق من الفعل ريحان والذي يعني النبات ذو الرائحة الجميلة، ورد ذكره في القرآن الكريم كرمز للخضرة والنعمة الإلهية، ويعتبر من الأسماء المحببة في الثقافة الإسلامية

in_urdu.name: ریحانہ
in_urdu.meaning: ریحانہ کا مطلب خوبصورت خوشبو دار پودا ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: ریحانہ نام عربی زبان کے الفاظ سے ماخوذ ہے، جو کہ خوبصورت خوشبو دار پودے کو کہا جاتا ہے، اسلامی ثقافت میں اس نام کو بہت اہمیت حاصل ہے، اور قرآن کریم میں بھی اس کا ذکر ہوا ہے

in_hindi.name: ریحانہ
in_hindi.meaning: रिहाना का अर्थ है सुंदर और सुगंधित पौधा
in_hindi.long_meaning: रिहाना नाम की उत्पत्ति अरबी भाषा से हुई है, जिसका अर्थ है सुंदर और सुगंधित पौधा, इस नाम का उल्लेख कुरआन में भी मिलता है, जो इसे एक पवित्र और शुभ नाम बनाता है

in_pashto.name: ريحانہ
in_pashto.meaning: ريحانہ د ښکلي بوی لرونکي ګل معنی
in_pashto.long_meaning: د ريحانہ نوم د عربي کلمو څخه اخيستل شوی دی، کوم چې ښکلي بوی لرونکي ګل ته وايي، په افغانستان او پاکستان کې د مسلمانانو په کلتور کې دا نوم ډیر مشهور دی

in_english.name: Rayhaanah
in_english.long_meaning: The name Rayhaanah originates from the Arabic root 'R-Ḥ-M' which signifies sweetness and fragrance, it refers to a sweet-smelling plant or fragrant herb, mentioned in the Quran as a symbol of divine blessings and mercy, making it a cherished name in Islamic tradition

data.cultural_impact: In Arabic, the name Rayhaanah is believed to have derived from the name of a sweet-smelling fragrant plant mentioned in the Quran. This plant evokes feelings of peace, joy, and tranquility. The name Rayhaanah, therefore, is associated with such pleasant and beautiful connotations in Islamic culture. It is also used as a feminine given name in the Arab world.
data.spiritual_significance: In the spiritual context, the name Rayhaanah is often interpreted as a reminder of an inner state of beauty and grace. It denotes the presence of garden-like qualities within an individual - beautiful, tranquil, and fragrant. It is also seen as a sign of paradise, a place of eternal peace and serenity. The name encourages its bearer to cultivate inner beauty, just as the sweet fragrance of the plant inspires one to appreciate the beauty of nature and creation.
